Who 3rd to right of P?
questions.explanation: P=1, 3rd right = pos 4 (Q? wait pos 4 = Q). Let me recount: P=1, S=2, W=3, Q=4. Yes Q at 4. But option says W=3 (option c). Adjust: 3rd to right means pos 4 from P's perspective counting next 3. P+3=pos 4=Q. Actually 'Nth right of X' typically = X's position + N. So P=1, 3rd right = pos 4 = Q. Adjust answer to (a).
